biggest_catch: Your friend must complete a long qualification list within 90 days (online banking, eStatements, debit card, 10 debit transactions, $250+ recurring direct deposit) - otherwise you get nothing.
catches: Referrer: existing Gesa Credit Union member over 18 in good standing; employees, board members, and business-only members are not eligible.
Referrer earns $50 for each eligible Referee submitted (up to a maximum of 10), i.e. up to $500; 'Referrers will receive $50, up to a maximum of $500, for each Referee.'

Referee must: use the referrer's referral code at account opening; become a member (savings, $5 minimum, $25 online) and open a SmartPlus checking account; within 90 days: sign up for online banking, enroll in eStatements, open a debit card, complete 10 qualifying debit card transactions (ATM excluded), and set up a recurring direct deposit of $250 or more.
Former Gesa members qualify as new only if previous membership was closed more than 90 days prior.
Incentives deposited into savings accounts within 90 days of meeting all qualifications; subject to IRS reporting.
Cannot be combined with other offers; early-closure fee may apply if account closed within first six months.
Program void where prohibited; Gesa may modify or cancel at any time.
